title: MCP Automation T1 Core
desc: Core MCP surface for WKAppBot. Covers the wkappbot_cli JSON-RPC contract, command mapping, and MCP registration smoke checks.
steps: Use wkappbot mcp as the stdio server entrypoint.
Map argv arrays directly to wkappbot CLI commands through wkappbot_cli.
Smoke-check with codex mcp list/get and wkappbot mcp --help before deeper work.
